uncertain.access: Docs confirm free account + free developer/test accounts with API access, and that Marketplace LISTING is manually reviewed (and needs 3 active installs). I did not find an explicit statement that an unlisted app with distribution='marketplace' can be OAuth-installed by arbitrary accounts without review; I believe it can (listing is optional), hence self_serve_free rather than approval_required. Worth a browser check.
uncertain.auth_methods: Developer API key (hapikey query param) only covers some app-management endpoints; static auth tokens and service keys are both Bearer tokens. Graders may reasonably omit api_key.

notes: HubSpot also publishes a separate local Developer MCP server (CLI-based) besides the remote mcp.hubspot.com; remote one requires OAuth with PKCE via an 'MCP connector' created in the HubSpot account. Usage guidelines list API rate limits for the Free tier, confirming API works on free CRM. API docs index lists ~1,182 pages for the 2026-09 API version alone. A web search snippet (HubSpot changelog, not opened) says the remote MCP server went GA effective April 13, 2026.
